requested_by: Omri 2026-09-28: 'it makes no sense that the clustering does not work for us; it has to be improved' - do not replace the L-SML rule, 'only maybe add another step'; focus on clustering and on the use of the estimates; run the proposed experiment after the diagnosis.
question: Does one label-free step added between L-SML's grouping and its weights (merge groups by the absorption ratio) repair the split of the level family and make L-SML at least as good as plain averaging of the same channels, on five banks? Separately: does Omri's band rule for the Dawid-Skene estimates (drop channels with estimated balanced accuracy in [0.45, 0.55], flip those below 0.45) improve on the current DS filter (keep > 0.5)?
provenance_of_the_merge_rule: The rule (rho < 0.5, smallest rho first, repeated) was designed on 2026-09-28 AFTER a label-free diagnosis on these same five banks (folds 0, 2, 4; results/expectation_realization_v1/stage_b_diagnostics/clustering_merge_diag_label_free.py, commit 045866f1f), after seeing that the Kaiser/VARCLUS rule (lambda_2 < 1) depends on group size. It used no labels, but it is not blind to these banks; this run is development evidence for a label-free rule, not a confirmation. External benchmarks are the later test.

banks.B13: stage A/B bank (bank11 + realized_z + realized_drv), as er_generality_v1
banks.B16: B13 + the three decoding-independent digit features of Codex (digit_alternative, digit_spread, digit_alternative_innovation; results/digit_family_extension_v1/FEATURES.npz, masked per-answer z-score = spectral_utils/digit_feature_family.answer_standardize; active on every step). They do not use disagreement with the chosen token (not covered by the 2026-09-17 exclusion). New bank.
banks.B51: 52-channel step pool minus the constant channel, native orientation, as er_generality_v1
banks.hygiene: channels with zero variance over all steps are removed (only hist_trace_length_series in B51, as before)

chain.marks_DS_filter_binary_partition_folds: unchanged from er_generality_v1 (top-20% random-tie marks, key default_rng(20260928); DS em_estimate 'ds' on the PRMBench fit-fold steps; binary partition = tail_calib_common.lsml_fit_scaled on tie-aware centred marks over all fit-fold steps; eval k, calibration (k+1)%5, fit on the other three; write-once; failed fits unscored)
chain.lsml_as_is: fit_fusion_weights mode 'continuous' (CONT L-SML: its own group search, within-group SML, cross-group SML, small_m_guard, anchor q15_H1 orientation) - unchanged
chain.added_step_merge: lsml_merge_step.absorb_merge(R, partition, thr=0.5, min_groups=3): R = Pearson correlation over all fit-fold steps of the same matrix the partition was found on (continuous values of the channels for L-SML's own partition; tie-aware centred marks for the binary partition). rho(A,B) = lambda_2(R[A u B]) / min(lambda_1(R[A]), lambda_1(R[B])); merge the pair with the smallest rho while rho < 0.5; never fewer than 3 groups. Ties: first pair in label order.
chain.lsml_weights_on_a_given_partition: fit_fusion_weights mode 'continuous' with groups = the (merged) partition: L-SML's own within-group and cross-group SML on the continuous values, unchanged
chain.band_rule: on the same DS estimate pi_hat: keep pi_hat > 0.55; flip (multiply by -1; marks recomputed on the flipped values) pi_hat < 0.45; drop 0.45 <= pi_hat <= 0.55
chain.position_adjusted_bank: stage-B definition: V - position profile (mean by answer length and step index on the PRMBench fit-fold steps), answer re-standardized; marks, DS filter, partitions and merge recomputed on it (suffix _pos)

arms_per_bank.ALL_lsml: L-SML as is on all channels (reference; its weights are the answer to Omri's question whether SML gives reversed channels a negative weight)
arms_per_bank.DSF_equal: DS filter (pi_hat > 0.5), then average - THE comparator for the central question
arms_per_bank.DSF_lsml: DS filter, L-SML as is (no added step)
arms_per_bank.DSF_lsml_mC: DS filter, L-SML's own partition, merge step, L-SML weights on the merged partition
arms_per_bank.DSF_lsml_B: DS filter, binary partition, L-SML weights on it (no merge) - isolates the partition source
arms_per_bank.DSF_lsml_mB: DS filter, binary partition, merge step, L-SML weights on the merged partition
arms_per_bank.DSF_Gbin: DS filter, binary partition, equal group weights (reference, er_generality_v1)
arms_per_bank.DSF_GmB: DS filter, merged binary partition, equal group weights
arms_per_bank.DSF_GmC: DS filter, merged L-SML partition, equal group weights
arms_per_bank.BD_equal: band rule without flipping (keep pi_hat > 0.55 only), then average
arms_per_bank.BF_equal: band rule with flipping, then average
arms_per_bank.BF_lsml: band rule with flipping, L-SML as is
arms_per_bank.BF_lsml_mB: band rule with flipping, binary partition, merge step, L-SML weights
arms_per_bank.position_replicate: DSF_equal, DSF_lsml, DSF_lsml_mC, DSF_lsml_mB, BF_equal on the position-adjusted bank (suffix _pos)

endpoints: PRMBench within-answer AUC and official PRMScore (primary); ProcessBench gate-free SLA macro 8 cells (reported beside; q4/q8 cells share answers)

primary: C1: does the added step improve L-SML on its own partition
C2: binary partition + added step vs L-SML as is
C3 (central): L-SML with the added step vs plain averaging of the same channels
C4: Omri's band rule with flipping vs the current DS filter
contrasts.primary_family: 4 contrasts x 5 banks x 2 PRMBench endpoints = 40, Bonferroni, 100,000 paired source-group draws (seed 20260927)
contrasts.secondary: per bank: DSF_lsml_mC - DSF_equal; DSF_lsml_B - DSF_lsml; DSF_lsml_mB - DSF_lsml_B; DSF_GmB - DSF_Gbin; DSF_GmB - DSF_equal; DSF_GmC - DSF_equal; BD_equal - DSF_equal; BF_equal - BD_equal; BF_lsml - DSF_lsml; BF_lsml_mB - DSF_lsml_mB; BF_lsml_mB - BF_equal; ALL_lsml - ALL_equal; position replicate of C1-C4; DSF_equal, DSF_lsml_mB, DSF_lsml_mC, BF_equal, BF_lsml_mB vs ct7 and fam421; 95% intervals; ProcessBench SLA of every contrast

nulls_and_robustness: for the 20 primary within-AUC contrasts: within-answer label shuffle and whole-answer same-length label swap, 200 permutations each (seeds 11, 12); concentration of every primary within-AUC gain: share from the top 1% of answers, the gain without them, 5%-trimmed mean of per-answer deltas, per-fold deltas
diagnostics_label_free: per bank, fold and partition source: partition before and after the merge, merge log with rho, number of groups, whether the level family (q15_H1, q15_VE1, logprob_margin, true_tail50, energy_level; names used for reporting only) sits in one group, partition identity across folds; L-SML weights of every arm
diagnostics_label_using_for_diagnosis_on: true balanced accuracy of every channel on the same rows; band decisions vs truth; class-conditional correlations on the PRMBench fit-fold steps split into pairs between and within groups, before and after the merge (the merge should move conditionally dependent pairs out of the between-group set, which is what L-SML's cross-group SML assumes); single-channel within-AUC; sign of ALL_lsml weights on truly reversed channels

interpretation_rule_frozen.per_contrast_and_bank: gain = Bonferroni interval above 0 on within-AUC; loss = below 0; otherwise no established difference
interpretation_rule_frozen.general: gain on at least 3 of the 5 banks and loss on none
interpretation_rule_frozen.C1_scope: C1 is counted only on banks where the step changed L-SML's own partition in at least 3 of 5 folds; elsewhere C1 is reported as 'step inactive'
interpretation_rule_frozen.central_answer: L-SML with the added step beats averaging iff C3 is general; it is 'at least as good as averaging' iff the C3 Bonferroni lower bound is above -0.002 on all five banks
interpretation_rule_frozen.band_answer: the band rule improves on the DS filter iff C4 is general
interpretation_rule_frozen.otherwise: not established; PRMScore, ProcessBench and position-adjusted results reported beside and never used to rescue a within-AUC failure; any gain whose same-length swap null mean is at least half of it is called mostly positional

predictions_frozen.P1: label-free: the merge changes the binary partition in every fold on B13, B16, B20, B51 and in no fold on B32; it changes L-SML's own partition on B13 and B16 only
predictions_frozen.P2: B13: the automatic merge of the binary partition equals the stage-B2 manual level merge in all 5 folds, so DSF_lsml_mB equals stage-B2 L_grp__merge (0.7788) exactly
predictions_frozen.P3: C1 and C2 points > 0 on B13 and B16
predictions_frozen.P4: C3 point < 0 on at least 3 of 5 banks (the step repairs the partition but L-SML's weights still do not beat averaging; stage B2: 0.7788 vs 0.7802)
predictions_frozen.P5: C4 point > 0 on B51 (reversed channels informative when flipped) and |C4| < 0.002 on B13 and B20
predictions_frozen.P6: after the merge, the mean |class-conditional correlation| between groups falls on every bank and fold where the merge fires
